```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a violin plot to show the distribution of megapixels across different sensor types
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='sensor_type', y='megapixels', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Megapixels by Sensor Type')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Megapixels')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
